text.title: Competitive Analysis (UX) Worked Example
text.summary: One end-to-end worked example of Competitive Analysis (UX) producing a valid spec artefact, anonymised for portability. Concrete e-commerce and SaaS examples of finding-to-insight conversion and analysis anti-patterns.

step.name: trigger
step.text: Engagement onboarded; the Competitive Analysis (UX) methodology was selected after Applies-If was satisfied (named owner Ruslan Faion, downstream consumer named in engagement charter, source-of-truth pinned in docs/).

step.name: apply-rules
step.text: Walked the rules from 01-core-rules.xml. Most rules passed on first review; one required a follow-up because a required citation was missing. Captured the gap, patched, re-ran.

step.name: produce
step.text: Filled templates/competitive-analysis.json with all required fields per the JSON Schema; emitted artefact_id with date; signed off by the engagement owner.

step.name: validate
step.text: Ran scripts/validate-competitive-analysis.py --file <path>; validator returned 0; smoke-test fixture in templates/_smoke-test.json also passed.

step.name: handover
step.text: Artefact registered with the downstream consumer; entry added to the engagement decision log; version locked at 1.1.0.

example.note: Finding: all 5 competitors offer guest checkout. Insight: guest checkout is table stakes — not having it is a competitive disadvantage, not a differentiator. Recommendation category: Must Have. Finding: only 1 competitor shows estimated delivery on the product page (before cart). Insight: opportunity to differentiate by surfacing delivery estimate earlier in the flow than any competitor does. Recommendation category: Could Differentiate.

Competitor comparison: A = 8 onboarding steps, 15 min to value. B = 3 steps, 2 min to value. C = 5 steps, 8 min to value. Competitor B has highest user ratings. Insight: minimal onboarding correlates with highest satisfaction — reducing steps is the primary lever. Recommendation: target 3-4 steps maximum and measure time-to-first-value as the success metric.
